prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: paper cut. Texture family: layered matte cardstock with soft fibrous paper grain, clean hand-cut edges, subtle raised layers and gentle shadow depth between cut forms. Palette: cool cyan and pale blue atmospheric tones, warm ivory anatomy forms, muted slate and lavender shadows, soft amber heat cues, and restrained coral accents for biological stress signals. Line treatment: minimal cut-edge silhouettes with occasional fine paper-layer contours and embossed-like shape definition rather than drawn outlines. Lighting: soft diffused studio-like illumination from above with gentle cast shadows revealing physical paper depth and scale relationships. Avoid: No enclosing pages or entry-object masks; no embedded text or unsupported factual imagery. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout. [VISUAL_CONTRACT:material_anchor_v2] Fill the canvas with a neutral material/palette sample, not a framed page, book, landscape, gateway, inset illustration or host.
